title: Plumeform hero (v2)
description: A dark band lit by a backdrop slot, with a centred heavy headline, a slate lead and a single pill CTA, then a large rounded frame (tall and phone-shaped on mobile, wide on desktop) whose border is a spinning mint-and-butter halo. The frame overhangs the band onto the paper below and grows to full size as you scroll (from 88% on desktop, 78% on phones). Headline and lead settle in on load, the CTA and frame rise in after them, and the backdrop fades in like an aurora.
notes: the band is dark by itself (dark class); the frame stays in the page's own colours
media fills the frame (an iframe, video or screenshot); backdrop fills the band (a video or WebGL scene); both are placeholders when empty
place it right after plumeform-v2-header: its top padding leaves room for the floating bar
name: plumeform-v2-hero
